description: Vehicle and Pedestrian Stop Data 2010 to June 30th, 2018 is a dataset listed in City of Los Angeles open data portal (data.lacity.org), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Los Angeles. NOTE: Legislation has increased the types of information collected regarding stops. These changes took effect on July 1, 2018 and are reflected in the data sets LAPD RIPA (AB 953) STOP Incident Details from 7/1/2018 to Present & LAPD RIPA (AB 953) STOP Person Detail from 7/1/2018 to Present. Coverage: Los Angeles. The portal files it under the category Public Safety. Its tags are lapd, stops, stop data, stop, safe city. The table has 16 columns. Attribution on the portal: Los Angeles Police Department. The portal shows 2022-09-03 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-lacity-org-portal.
